description: 豊田市駅周辺の歩行者交通量データ [roads, bridges and tunnels and railways and stations] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 豊田市. 豊田市駅周辺に設置している歩行者通行料自動計算装置（パロッシー）のデータを過去3年分公開します。. Coverage: 豊田市. The portal files it under the publisher 豊田市. Its tags are 企業, 位置情報, 公共事業, 商業_サービス業, 経済. It offers 37 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-05-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
